name: com.gameframex.unity.login.google
description:
Google login channel package for the GameFrameX Login registry. Implements ILoginManager as GoogleLoginManager and self-registers into LoginChannelRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via GoogleLoginBootstrap (channel id Google), macro-walled to Android / iOS (incl. the Editor with a matching build target) so registration itself defines the default channel; installing the package is all it takes. Returns GoogleLoginResult, a LoginResult subclass carrying the IdToken in the unified Token field plus FamilyName / GivenName / PlayerId (also written to OpenId); reads googleProjectId via BlankGetChannel, with a stub sign-in in the Editor. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Login 的 Google 登录渠道功能包。以 GoogleLoginManager 实现 ILoginManager，经 GoogleLoginBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 自注册进 LoginChannelRegistry（渠道标识 Google），Bootstrap 宏墙限定 Android / iOS（含 Editor 对应构建目标），注册即平台默认渠道，装包即生效。返回 LoginResult 子类 GoogleLoginResult，IdToken 由统一 Token 字段承载，并保留 FamilyName / GivenName / PlayerId（同时写入 OpenId）；经 BlankGetChannel 读取 googleProjectId，Editor 下返回桩数据供流程验证。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
